pairs: Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
Let my doctrine accumulate like the rain.
Let my eloquence form like the dew,
like a mist upon the plants,
and like water droplets upon the grass.
For I will invoke the name of the Lord.
Acknowledge the magnificence of our God!
The works of God are perfect,
and all his ways are judgments.
Deus fidelis, et absque ulla iniquitate,
God is faithful and without any iniquity.
et non filii ejus in sordibus:
and in their filth they are not his sons.
They are a depraved and perverse generation.
How can this be the return you would offer to the Lord,
numquid non ipse est pater tuus,
Is he himself not your Father,
and he will declare it to you.
and they will tell it to you.
When the Most High divided the nations,
when he separated the sons of Adam,
constituit terminos populorum juxta numerum filiorum Israël.
he appointed the limits of the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.
But the Lord’s portion is his people:
He discovered him in a desert land,
et custodivit quasi pupillam oculi sui.
and he guarded him like the pupil of his eye,
Sicut aquila provocans ad volandum pullos suos,
just as an eagle encourages its young to fly,
and carries them on its shoulders.
The Lord alone was his leader,
et non erat cum eo deus alienus:
and there was no strange god with him.
He stood him upon an exalted land,
so that he might eat the fruits of the fields,
so that he might eat honey from the rock,
and oil from the hardest stone,
et lac de ovibus cum adipe agnorum,
and milk from the sheep, with fat from the lambs,
et arietum filiorum Basan: et hircos cum medulla tritici,
and with rams and goats from the sons of Bashan, with the kernel of the wheat,
and so that he might drink the undiluted blood of the grape.
Having grown fat and thick and wide,
et recessit a Deo salutari suo.
They provoked him with strange gods,
et in abominationibus ad iracundiam concitaverunt.
and they stirred him to anger by their abominations.
They immolated to demons and not to God,
to gods whom they did not know,
who were new and recent arrivals,
whom their fathers did not worship.
You have forsaken the God who conceived you,
et oblitus es Domini creatoris tui.
and you have forgotten the Lord who created you.
and he was stirred to anger.
quia provocaverunt eum filii sui et filiæ.
For his own sons and daughters provoked him.
‘I will hide my face from them,
and I will consider their very end.
For this is a perverse generation,
Ipsi me provocaverunt in eo qui non erat Deus,
They have provoked me with that which was not God,
and they have angered me with their emptiness.
et ego provocabo eos in eo qui non est populus,
And so, I will provoke them with that which is not a people,
et in gente stulta irritabo illos.
and I will anger them with a foolish nation.
Ignis succensus est in furore meo,
A fire has been kindled in my fury,
et ardebit usque ad inferni novissima:
and it will burn even to the deepest Hell,
and it will devour the earth with its produce,
and it will burn the foundations of the mountains.
I will heap evils upon them,
et sagittas meas complebo in eis.
and I will expend my arrows among them.
They will be consumed by famine,
et devorabunt eos aves morsu amarissimo:
and birds with a very bitter bite will devour them.
I will send forth the teeth of wild beasts among them,
along with the fury of creatures that scurry across the ground,
Outside, the sword will devastate them; and inside,
as much for the young man as for the maiden,
and as much for the newborn as for the old man.
cessare faciam ex hominibus memoriam eorum.
I will cause their memory to cease from among men.
But because of the wrath of the enemies, I have delayed it.
ne forte superbirent hostes eorum, et dicerent:
Otherwise, perhaps their enemies would be arrogant and would say:
et non Dominus, fecit hæc omnia.
and not the Lord, has done all these things.”
They are a nation without counsel
I wish that they would be wise
and would provide for the very end.’
How is it that one pursues a thousand,
nonne ideo, quia Deus suus vendidit eos,
Is it not because their God has sold them,
and because the Lord has enclosed them?
Non enim est Deus noster ut dii eorum:
For our God is not like their gods.
Their vines are of the vines of Sodom,
but from the suburbs of Gomorrah.
Their grapes are the grapes of gall,
and their grape clusters are most bitter.
Their wine is the gall of snakes,
and it is the incurable venom of asps.
Nonne hæc condita sunt apud me,
‘Have not these things been stored up with me,
and sealed up amid my treasures?
and I will repay them in due time,
so that their foot may slip and fall.
The day of perdition is near,
and the time rushes to appear.’
The Lord will judge his people,
and he will take pity on his servants.
He will see that their hand has been weakened,
and that those who have been enclosed have likewise failed,
and that those who have been left behind have been consumed.
They ate the fat of their victims,
and they drank the wine of their libations.
and protect you in your distress.
et non sit alius deus præter me:
and there is no other god beside me.
and I will cause to live.
et non est qui de manu mea possit eruere.
And there is no one who is able to rescue from my hand.
I will lift up my hand to heaven,
Si acuero ut fulgur gladium meum,
When I sharpen my sword like lightning,
and my hand takes hold of judgment,
then I will render vengeance to my enemies,
et his qui oderunt me retribuam.
and I will repay those who hate me.
I will inebriate my arrows with blood,
and my sword will devour flesh:
de cruore occisorum et de captivitate,
from the blood of the slain and from the captive,
from the exposed head of the enemies.’
For he will avenge the blood of his servants.
et vindictam retribuet in hostes eorum,
And he will distribute vengeance to their enemies.
et propitius erit terræ populi sui.
And he will be merciful to the land of his people.”
et locutus est omnia verba cantici hujus in auribus populi,
Moses went and spoke all the words of this canticle to the ears of the people,
And he completed all these words,
Ponite corda vestra in omnia verba,
“Set your hearts upon all the words which I am testifying to you this day.
So shall you command your sons,
ut mandetis ea filiis vestris custodire
et implere universa quæ scripta sunt legis hujus:
and to fulfill all the things that have been written in this law.
quia non incassum præcepta sunt vobis,
For these things have not been entrusted to you to no purpose,
sed ut singuli in eis viverent:
but so that each one would live by them,
quæ facientes longo perseveretis tempore in terra,
you may continue for a long time in the land,
which you will enter upon crossing the Jordan in order to possess it.”
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in eadem die,
And the Lord spoke to Moses on the same day,
qui est in terra Moab contra Jericho:
which is in the land of Moab, opposite Jericho,
and look upon the land of Canaan,
quam ego tradam filiis Israël obtinendam,
which I will deliver to the sons of Israel to obtain it.
And you shall die upon the mountain.
After climbing it, you will be joined to your people,
sicut mortuus est Aaron frater tuus in monte Hor,
just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor,
and was placed with his people.
quia prævaricati estis contra me in medio filiorum Israël ad aquas contradictionis in Cades deserti Sin:
For you trespassed against me in the midst of the sons of Israel, at the Waters of Contradiction, in Kadesh,
et non sanctificastis me inter filios Israël.
in the desert of Sin. And you did not sanctify me among the sons of Israel.
You shall see the land opposite you,
which I will give to the sons of Israel,
but you shall not enter into it.”
